body:
**Verification:** Production testing is done. Smoke tested the Email Sent from Saleshandy trigger on Production, all 10 activities:

| # | Activity | What was checked | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Create a Account in Salesforce | One Account created, named like the prospect's full name, with Website, Billing City, Billing State/Province and Billing Country from the prospect. | Pass |
| 2 | Update a Account in Salesforce | With an Account named like the prospect's full name, the mapped values (Phone, Billing City) show the prospect's. | Pass, working as intended |
| 3 | Create a Contact in Salesforce | Contact created with the mapped values and no Lead created. | Pass |
| 4 | Update a Contact in Salesforce | Business Phone and Department show the prospect's values, still one Contact. | Pass |
| 5 | Create a Lead in Salesforce | Exactly one Lead created with the mapped values as entered (accented and apostrophe names), Lead Status "Open - Not Contacted". | Pass |
| 6 | Update a Lead in Salesforce | Title, Phone and Company show the prospect's values, still one Lead. | Pass |
| 7 | Create a Opportunity in Salesforce | One Opportunity with Stage Prospecting, Close Date today + 1 and Amount 5000, tied to the Contact. Closing date 0 Days cannot be saved (AL-4168). | Pass |
| 8 | Update a Opportunity in Salesforce | With 3 Opportunities on the Contact, the latest gets Stage Qualification and Close Date today + 2, the other two are unchanged. Closing date 0 Days cannot be saved (AL-4168). | Pass |
| 9 | Attach Note in Salesforce | Paired with Create a Contact and Create a Lead, one Note on the Contact and on the Lead. | Pass |
| 10 | Record (log) an Email Activity in Salesforce | Paired with Update a Contact and Create a Opportunity, the email shows on the Contact timeline, and on the Opportunity and the Contact. | Pass |

**Note:** Update a Account looks the Account up by the prospect's full name, not the Company, so an Account named like the Company is not updated.
waitingFor: QA to check the wording and send via npm run jira. Source: Email Sent from Saleshandy (Salesforce) Production smoke run 2026-10-22, sequence 979437, account emailopenedprod, dev org saleshandy-dev-ed. Row 2 status set by QA (Pass, working as intended).
